meta.notes:
## Kuaishou recipe notes

Re-checked 2026-11-13 (iPhone UA 390x844, logged out, headless Chromium): `https://m.kuaishou.com/` is still only the static brand landing page. **The real web app (`www.kuaishou.com/brilliant`, desktop UA) timed out again (about 50 s, no response), so feed, video, profile and live pages are NOT verified.** Nothing in the options touches those pages; adding rules for them would be guesswork.

## LIVE (landing page)

- First version, unchanged: `.com-download-bar` 1, `a.open-or-download-app-main` 1, `.cover .arrrow-wrapper` 1, `.open-in-browser-dialog` 1, `.open-app-confirm-dialog` 1 (both display:none until an app-open attempt), `.com-header li.nav.highlight` 1
- New: `.title-pic .pic-wrapper` 3 and `.title-pic .pic-wrapper img.pic` 3 (screenshots), `.page-content .title-pic` 3 (headline blocks), `.cover img.slogan` 1, `.com-header .navs > li.nav:has(> a > span.triangle)` 2 (APP and About menus), `.com-icp` 1

## Notes

- The landing page is small and static; the new options exist for people who open Kuaishou links in the browser and want a quiet page. Header home link, the Download button (under "app prompts") and the ICP legal links are kept unless the matching option is on.
- Community sources searched (greasyfork kuaishou.com scripts, uBlock/AdGuard lists) hold no cosmetic rules for m.kuaishou.com; all additions are LIVE-counted on the page above.
